record.paper_title: Ultra-Dense Cell-Free Massive MIMO for 6G: Technical Overview and Open Questions
record.original_question: Which emerging physical infrastructure can realize cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CF-MMIMO) at scale, and how can Radio Stripes, pCell-like centralized distributed antenna systems, and RadioWeaves-style integrated distributed antennas overcome practical limits involving fronthaul capacity, data processing, synchronization, mobility, initial access, energy efficiency, and support for energy-neutral backscatter devices?

evidence.quote: CF-MMIMO requires a widespread and costly architecture to implement the user-centric philosophy, accurate synchronization and coordination among the APs to carry out the joint coherent transmission/reception, and practical resource allocation schemes to capitalize on the macro-diversity gain, while preserving the network scalability.
On the other hand, the Radio Stripe system cannot be the ideal solution for any large-scale distributed deployment.
It is fundamentally difficult in pCell, or any such CF-MMIMO system, to support substantial mobility, given the CSI and user-centered synchronization requirements.
One important technical challenge in constructing RadioWeaves system is, down-to-earth, to handle the vast amounts of baseband data, and process them in real time.
A fifth is the integration of service of energy-neutral devices that communicate via backscattering.

artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and research papers (2023–2025) on Radio Stripes, pCell, and RadioWeaves continue to list fronthaul scalability, distributed synchronization, mobility-robust user-centric clustering, scalable initial access, and integration with backscatter/ambient IoT as unresolved research challenges for ultra-dense CF-MMIMO, with no single architecture demonstrated to meet all constraints simultaneously.

status_evidence.title: Ultra-Dense Cell-Free Massive MIMO for 6G: Technical Overview and Open Questions
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Radio Stripes, pCell, and RadioWeaves and explicitly lists fronthaul, synchronization, mobility, initial access, energy efficiency, and backscatter support as open challenges.
status_evidence.claim: The infrastructure choices and listed limits remain open research questions.

status_evidence.title: Scalable Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces scalability constraints (fronthaul, complexity, power control) for cell-free networks; constraints remain active areas.
status_evidence.claim: Scalability bottlenecks of CF-MMIMO are widely treated as unsolved.

status_evidence.title: RadioWeaves for Ultra-Reliable Low Latency Communication
status_evidence.snippet: Proposes RadioWeaves concept but notes real-time baseband processing of vast data as a key open challenge.
status_evidence.claim: Real-time processing in RadioWeaves explicitly listed as open.
